title: Record an expense
text: Record money the shop spends, such as rent, power, or repairs. Each branch has its own expense list.
steps: Click Sidebar > Expenses.
Click Add Expense.
Enter the expense name, type, date, and amount.
Add a supplier, invoice number, or receipt number if available.
Attach a receipt photo if needed, then click Save.

title: Same expense on several dates
text: Use one expense entry for multiple dates. A separate row is saved for each date.
steps: Click Sidebar > Expenses.
Click Add Expense and enter the expense details.
In the Date field, select all dates for the expense.
Click Save. Each selected date appears in its own row.

title: Expense types
text: Expense types group expenses, such as Rent or Marketing. All branches share the same types.
steps: Click Sidebar > Expenses.
Open the All Types dropdown in the top bar.
Click Add to create a type.
Use the pencil to rename a type or the bin to delete it.
You cannot delete a type that is still in use. Move those expenses to another type first.
Choose a type from the dropdown to show only those expenses.

title: Filter expenses by date
text: Filter expenses by date. The totals update to match your selected dates.
steps: Click Sidebar > Expenses.
Click Select Period in the top bar.
Choose a preset such as This Month, or enter a start and end date.
Use All Types or the search box to narrow the results.

title: What the three totals mean
text: Operating Expenses are your recorded expenses. COGS is the cost of products sold. Business Expenses is both totals combined.
steps: Change the branch, dates, or type to update the totals.
COGS comes from sales, not the expense list. It can appear on a day with no recorded expense.
Products still in stock are not counted until they are sold.
Click the COGS card to open the full report.

title: Edit or delete an expense
text: Edit an expense to change its details, or delete it permanently.
steps: Click Sidebar > Expenses.
Find the expense using the search box or date filter.
Click the arrow at the end of the row.
Click Edit, make your changes, and click Save.
Or click Delete to remove the expense permanently.

title: Print or export expenses
text: Print or export the expenses shown on screen as Print, PDF, or Excel.
steps: Click Sidebar > Expenses.
Set the period, branch, and type filters.
Click Print & Export in the top bar.
Choose Print, PDF, or Excel.
